title: Shiraishi An — We're About To Open!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: COL

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This feels weird...
We actually get to stand on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Up we go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You coming, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Getting to see COL again's one thing.
But to stand on the stage where everything happened...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Dad was here. This is what he saw...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This place was completely packed, and he stood here as he sang...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Being a basement venue, it felt like an earthquake was happening every time the crowd roared. Also...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's trying to imagine what happened that night as she sings.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (How it felt to be there, what Dad and the others were like, how everyone sang.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Then, why don't I...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to keep finding ways to reach that level...!!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I don't want it to just be a dream...
I want to sing with Kohane by my side!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(This is so cool...!
We're actually singing at COL...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Where our dream... No, where everything started...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Alright, if that's how it's gonna be...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wanna sing too...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Not so fast you three...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Yeah, there we go!
Just like that until the chorus and...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This is awesome! We're way more in sync now compared to when we practice!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Whoa! More?!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, let's dance!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Sing with everything you've got!
Like there's no tomorrow!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You know what this means, right, Kohane, Toya?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That look. She wants us to keep singing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (You got it, An!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Perfect! That couldn't have gone any better!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(This is the best feeling in the world!
It's like we're really pushing each other in the right direction!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's funny too...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We're singing acapella, but it's like the music for this song's playing at the same time.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Are the others feeling the same thing?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Singing with them... It's just the best!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Three years have passed since that night...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But now, I have the cutest partner ever and a team that's chasing after a single goal!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I hope I get to introduce them to you someday, Aunt Nagi.)
